units.name: City of Portland
units.notes: Portland’s newly reformed municipal government under a 12-member council and professional City Administrator. Responsible for police, fire, drinking water, sewers, parks, and city roads.

units.name: Multnomah County
units.notes: Oregon’s most populous county. Administers social safety nets, public health clinics, mental health crisis response, the library system, jails, juvenile justice, and Willamette River bridges.

units.name: Metro Regional Government
units.notes: The nation’s only directly elected regional government, serving 1.8M residents across Clackamas, Multnomah, and Washington counties. Manages regional land use, supportive housing, solid waste, the Oregon Zoo, and regional parks.

units.name: TriMet Transit District
units.notes: Tri-County Metropolitan Transportation District of Oregon. Provides bus, MAX light rail, WES commuter rail, and LIFT paratransit service across 533 square miles of the Portland metro area.

units.name: Portland Public Schools
units.notes: Oregon’s largest PK-12 urban school district, serving approximately 44,000 students across 81 school campuses. Funded primarily through State School Fund formula allocations and local property tax levies/bonds.
